headline: Turkey's Automotive Exports Hit 8-Month Record: 27.2 Billion Dollars
summary: Turkey's automotive industry raised exports 2.5% in the first eight months of the year to $27.2 billion. Germany was the largest market and Kocaeli became the leading production hub.
why: The automotive sector is one of Turkey's largest export industries, and its performance affects trade balances and manufacturing employment.
